gloss: to tidy up, to put away

definitions.gloss: to tidy up, to clean up
definitions.explanation: To organize and clean a space by putting things in their proper places.
To return items to their designated storage location.
To complete or resolve a task or matter.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}を{片付|かたづ}けてください。
{本|ほん}を{本棚|ほんだな}に{片付|かたづ}けた。
examples.english: I put the books away on the bookshelf.
examples.notes: に marks where items are put

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}を{早|はや}く{片付|かたづ}けたい。
examples.english: I want to finish this work quickly.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {片付|かたづ}く (intransitive, to be tidied up). Pattern: Xを{片付|かたづ}ける (tidy up X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action or resulting state. {片付|かたづ}けている = 'is tidying' or 'has tidied.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{部屋|へや}を{片付|かたづ}ける (tidy up a room)
・{机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}を{片付|かたづ}ける (clear the desk)
・{仕事|しごと}を{片付|かたづ}ける (finish/wrap up work)
・{問題|もんだい}を{片付|かたづ}ける (settle a problem)

INTRANSITIVE PAIR: {片付|かたづ}く means 'to be tidied/settled.'
・{部屋|へや}が{片付|かたづ}いた (The room is tidy now.)

REGISTER: Neutral. Very common in everyday speech.
